So this is the tablet. Thank you.
strings.(베이넌이 석판을 받아 들고 이리저리 살펴본다.): (Beinan takes the tablet and examines it from every angle.)
Before I was born into this body, I lived in Knossos.
And I followed her from Freios to Eastland...
strings.아마 그때 모스 왕국이 프레이오스의 전투에서 패해서 이스트랜드로 건너왔던: It must have been when the Kingdom of Mos crossed over to Eastland after its defeat in Freios...
strings.(베이넌의 동공이 풀린 듯 눈동자의 초점이 사라진다.): (Beinan's eyes go vacant, losing their focus.)
strings.베이넌? 정신 차려, 베이넌!!: Beinan? Snap out of it, Beinan!!
strings.(메디아가 심호흡을 한 후 들고 있던 지팡이로 베이넌의 어깨를 톡톡 두드: (Medea takes a deep breath and taps Beinan's shoulder with her staff.)
No effect. I'm sorry, Beinan. Bear with me for a moment.
strings.(메디아가 다시 지팡이를 들어 베이넌의 복부를 향해 휘두른다.): (Medea raises her staff again and swings it into Beinan's stomach.)
strings.끼야아아아!! 베이넌, 왜 여기까지 날아온 거야?: Aaaah!! Beinan, why did you come flying all the way over here?
Beinan will be fine. Don't worry too much.
I see you visited Lady Pasiphae.
strings.아, 그 골렘을 가지고 있던 아이가 떠오르는군요. 어쩌면 그 아이를 찾아: Ah, that reminds me of the child with the golem. Perhaps the one who came to see her was...
strings.탈로스의 계획이 아직 무엇인지 모르겠지만, 그 아이에게 영향을 줄 것입니: I still don't know what Talos is planning, but it will affect that child.
strings.네…. 그러면 저는 이 석판으로 뭘 할 수 있을지 방법을 더 찾아보겠습니: Please do... Meanwhile, I'll see what else we might be able to do with this tablet.
Then I'll see you later, Lady Medea.
strings.아, 베이넌…. 괜찮습니까?: Ah, Beinan... Are you all right?
strings.…오랜만이라 방심했습니다. 그건 그렇고 이 석판에서 확실히 그분의 영향을: ...It had been so long, I let my guard down. In any case, I could clearly feel her influence in this tablet...
That is what she made it for.
Lady Medea, you feel different since you went away...
strings.…'밤'을 준비하고 있어요. 그분과 맞설 그날, 당장은 아니겠지만, 때가: ...I'm preparing for the 'night.' The day we face her. It may not be soon, but when the time comes...
I think I'll put other thoughts aside and read today. You should rest too, Beinan.
strings.안 그래도 모험가님을 생각하긴 했는데,: I was just thinking of you.
strings.그냥 저번에 제 일도 도와주셨는데, 제대로 감사 인사도 못 드려서 죄송했: You helped me out before, and I felt bad that I hadn't thanked you properly.
Someone was worried about you, so I've come to see how you're doing.
strings.괜찮지 못하면 여기서 지낼 수 없거든요. 마도리가 아니었다면, 다른 분들: I have to be, to keep living here. If it weren't for Madori and everyone else's help...
strings.저기, 모험가님. 물어볼 게 있어요. 절 걱정하셨다는 분, 혹시…. 저와: Adventurer, may I ask something? This person who was worried about me... Do they look like me? Ears like these...
Yes, that's right. She leads a tribe called the Kali on another continent.
strings.혹시 초인 메디아 님인가요?: Do you mean Lady Medea, the Champion?
strings.교수님에게 이야기를 들었어요. 일반 사람들과는 달리 강한 힘으로 많은 사: The professor told me about her. About people with far greater power than ordinary humans, who use it to protect others.
I'm grateful that someone like her would be concerned about me.
strings.모험가님, 크노소스에 다녀오신 거죠?: Adventurer, you've been to Knossos, haven't you?
How did you know? I had something to do there recently.
Well, with what you said about her, and the person who visited me before... I had a feeling you might have been there.
Please tell me about your visit to Knossos, Adventurer.
You must be curious about it. I'll give you the short version...
strings.(나르샤에게 크노소스에서 본 풍경을 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly describe the sights you saw in Knossos to Narsha.)
strings.(크노소스의 이야기를 듣는 나르샤의 표정이 상기된다. 눈빛이 반짝거리는: (Narsha grows excited as she listens. Her sparkling eyes suggest something has caught her interest.)
strings.골렘이요? 골렘 모양의 바위들이 있다구요?!: Golems? There are rocks shaped like golems?!
That's right. I saw them there.
strings.(아, 이렇게 좋아하는데, 뭔가 구해서 가져다줄까? 가면서 한 번 더 탈: (She's so excited. Maybe I could bring her something? While I'm there, I should ask Talos about her again.)
strings.나르샤, 크노소스 물건 하나 구해다 줄까요?: Narsha, would you like me to bring you something from Knossos?
strings.네, 네, 네, 네, 네, 네!!: Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!!
strings.(나르샤의 눈빛이 너무 반짝거려 도저히 쳐다볼 수 없을 정도로 빛난다.): (Narsha's eyes shine so brightly that it is almost impossible to look at her.)
I think your eyes are about to shoot beams.
strings.네, 선생님! 훌륭하세요! 그럼 기다릴게요!: Yes, Teacher! You're wonderful! I'll be waiting!
strings.저는 총장님이 부르셔서 가볼게요. 그러니 선생님, 조심하세요!: The president called for me, so I have to go. Take care, Teacher!
strings.(흐음, 그러면 다시 크노소스로 가볼까? 탈로스에게 먼저 가서 물어봐야겠: (Hmm, back to Knossos, then? I'll talk to Talos first.)
I told you to visit often, and now you're almost a nuisance. You really must...
strings.역시 전 당신에게 관심 별로 없어요. 그냥 궁금한 게 있어서 왔으니 묻는: I really must tell you I'm not interested in you. I came because I have questions, so please just answer them.
Hahaha. I did invite you to come often, so I can hardly complain.
I came to ask you something, Talos...
So I have nothing to say.
strings.(아, 저번엔 은근 짜증 났는데, 이번엔 대놓고 짜증 나네….): (Last time he was mildly irritating. Now he's just plain infuriating...)
What a shame. It would be more entertaining if you said your thoughts aloud.
strings.됐고, 당신…. 마도골렘을 빼앗아 무슨 일을 하려고 했던거죠?: Enough. What were you planning to do with that magic golem you tried to take?
strings.마도골렘? 무슨 소린지 잘 모르겠는데?: Magic golem? I'm not sure what you mean.
strings.분명 동물 귀를 가진 남자가 크노소스에서 나와 길드연합으로 왔다고 들었: I heard that a man with animal ears left Knossos and came to the Guild Union.
strings.그리고 크노소스에 남아있는 동물 귀 남자는 밖으로 나오지 못하는 미노스: And apart from Lord Minos, who can't get out, you're the only man with animal ears left in Knossos.
strings.아, 그래? 명탐정 %s 납시었군. 그런데 그게 내가 아닌데 어쩌지?: Is that so? The great detective %s has arrived. But what will you do if it wasn't me?
strings.(탈로스가 한 손으로 머리 위에 달린 귀를 막는다.): (Talos covers the ears on top of his head with one hand.)
strings.(하긴 귀가 저기 있으니 저길 막는 게 당연한 건데…. 아, 기분 나쁘네: (Well, that's where his ears are, so of course he'd cover them there... But it's still irritating.)
You seem to need something. Go see the Beastman King rampaging in there instead.
Keep him entertained for a while and he'll give you something worthwhile. He's a surprisingly troublesome fellow. Sigh.
strings.그럼 난 이만, 아퀼라랑 나쿤 놈들이 몰려왔다가 쓰레기를 안 치우고 가서: I'm off, then. A flock of Aquila and Nakun came by and left their rubbish behind. I have cleaning to do.
Those creatures... All they do is make a fuss. Such a nuisance.
He's a keeper in a rather different sense of the word. Sigh...
He said to see Lord Minos. Let's head to Acro's Coffin.
strings.(아크로의 관 안으로 들어가자마자 마치 기다리고 있었던 것처럼 미노스가: (As soon as you enter Acro's Coffin, Minos approaches slowly, as though he has been waiting.)
Your arrival tells me the goddess has answered.
strings.저, 아직 미노스 님과 파시파에 님이 밖에 나갈 수 있는 방법은 찾지 못: I'm afraid I haven't found a way for you and Lady Pasiphae to get out yet.
That is all right. If it were easy, I would have broken out myself long ago.
I am grateful that you have returned at all.
strings.내게 말해도 괜찮다. 내가 도와줄 수 있는 거라면 도와주겠다. 여신께서도: You may tell me. If it is within my power, I will help. The goddess gives her approval as well...
strings.…여신님의 목소리가 들려오는군. 놀랍다. 너와 함께 있으니 점점 더 선명: ...I hear the goddess' voice. Remarkable. In your presence, it grows clearer and clearer...
strings.메데이아, 아니 메디아의 말대로 이스트랜드는 쉽게 다가가실 수 있겠지만,: As Medeia—Medea said, Eastland may be easy for her to reach, but Freios is not yet so.
An ominous power, unlike that of a god, fills Freios and many other places...
strings.너는 모르는 건가? 흠…. 그건 그 아이의 아명(兒名) 같은 것이다. 다: You did not know? Hmm... It is something of a childhood name. What Daphne used to call her.
In any case, tell me why you have come.
strings.(인간의 마을에 마도골렘을 다루는 소녀가 있고, 그 소녀에게 줄만한 것: (You explain that a girl in a human town operates a magic golem, and that you are looking for something to give her.)
So one of the golems is with a girl in a human town...
strings.아마도 그 아이는 나와 파시파에 같은 모습을 하고 있을 것이다. 그러면: She probably looks like Pasiphae and me. If so, she would be one of our people.
strings.어떻게 해서 그 아이가 인간들과 함께 있고, 그 골렘을 손에 넣었는지는: I do not know how she came to live among humans or acquire that golem, but...
In any case, %s, I have something you could give her...
strings.뭔가 원한다면 그에 상응하는 값을 치르면 된다. 잠깐 나와 대련하는 것이: If you desire something, pay a fitting price. If that price is merely a brief sparring match with me, should you not consider yourself fortunate?
I will wait at the far end of Acro's Coffin. Until then...
strings.(미노스의 말이 끝나자마자 그의 모습이 환영처럼 흩어져 사라진다.): (As soon as Minos finishes speaking, his figure disperses like an illusion.)
Those two really are a couple. They both say their piece and demand a fight.
No choice, then. Better get going.
That was enjoyable. Here, take this to the child.
This looks like an electrical wire...
strings.고대 시절, 우리는 하늘에서 떨어진 어떤 골렘의 것을 보고 이걸 만들었다: In ancient times, we made this after studying one from a golem that fell from the sky. It is also called a cable, but we called it a Cord of the Mind.
It was what made the golems move...
I do not know what the child will do with it, but it should be of use.
It was simply something I had. Now, return to her.
And come visit again. That is how we will learn to trust one another.
strings.파시파에를 며칠 보지 못한 것뿐인데, 답답하군. 대체 녀석은 우리를 가둬: It has only been a few days since I saw Pasiphae, yet I feel so restless. What could he fear so much that he would lock us away...
strings.어, 선생님. 오셨어요?! 기다렸어요!: Oh, Teacher! You're back?! I've been waiting!
strings.아직 그 호칭 익숙하지 않은데…. 일단, 이거 받아요. 도움이 될지 모르: I'm still not used to being called that... Anyway, here. I don't know if it'll help, but...
strings.(나르샤가 두 눈을 반짝이며 %s에게서 전기 케이블을 받는다.): (Eyes sparkling, Narsha accepts the electrical cable from %s.)
strings.이걸 주신 분께서 하늘에서 떨어진 어떤 골렘의 것을 보고 만들었다고 하셨: The person who gave it to me said it was modeled on something from a golem that fell from the sky. A Cord of the Mind, he called it...
strings.부품이 모여서 이런 케이블을 이어서 완성하면 뭔가 될 것 같긴 해요. 아: If I gather the parts and connect them with a cable like this, I think I could make something. I'll try it with Anise.
strings.잠시만요, 하늘에서 떨어진 어떤 골렘이면 모험가님이 상대하신 그 골렘일: Wait. A golem that fell from the sky? Could it be the one you fought, Adventurer?
strings.흐음, 어렵네요. 선생님…. 그런데, 이걸 주신 분은 어떻게 생기셨어요?: Hmm, this is tricky, Teacher... What did the person who gave you this look like?
Yes. He had ears like yours, Narsha.
strings.…나중에 때가 되면 만나고 싶어요. 이야기를 듣다 보니 그분들과 계속 만: ...I'd like to meet them when the time is right. The more I hear, the more I want to see them.
Thank you for looking out for me, Teacher. Please tell me if there's ever anything you need. I'll find a way to help.
strings.어쩌면 마도리와 골렘에 대한 정보 속에 선생님이 찾으시는 것도 있을지 모: Something you're looking for might even turn up in the information on Madori and the golems.
Thank you, Narsha. I'll be off, then.
strings.생각해보니 그때 선생님께서 구해주신 부품에 연결이 될 것 같네. 한 번: Come to think of it, this might connect to the part Teacher found for me before. Let's try it!
